title: 指标与取数
Metrics and querying
purpose: 把业务问题变成可复算的口径，再关联和汇总数据。
Define a reproducible metric, then join and aggregate its data.

title: 指标口径
Metric definition
lesson: 先写清记录粒度、分子、分母、时间窗口及排除条件。指标改口径要保留版本。
Specify grain, numerator, denominator, time window and exclusions. Version any change.

title: SQL 表关联
SQL joins
lesson: 先核对键和关系基数。右侧多行会使左侧记录展开。关联后比较行数和唯一键数量。
Check keys and cardinality first. Multiple right-side rows expand a left-side record. Compare rows and distinct keys after joining.

title: 分组与汇总
Grouping and aggregation
lesson: 在聚合前筛记录，在聚合后筛分组。比率要先确认有效分母，不能直接平均不同规模组的比率。
Filter rows before aggregation and groups after it. Check denominators before combining rates across unequal groups.

title: 数据质量
Data quality
purpose: 识别异常、保留原值，并把质量检查变成可重复规则。
Find defects, preserve raw values and turn quality checks into repeatable rules.

title: 缺失值与有效分母
Missing values and denominators
lesson: 区分没有记录、无测量值和有效零。为每项指标明确缺失值的排除条件。
Distinguish missing records, missing measurements and genuine zeroes. Define exclusion rules per metric.

title: 重复与冲突记录
Duplicate and conflicting rows
lesson: 先定义同一实体的键。完全重复可按规则去重，同键不同值需要溯源和裁决。
Define the entity key first. Exact duplicates can be deduplicated by rule. Conflicting records need traceable resolution.

title: 质量规则与复核
Quality rules and review
lesson: 围绕用途选择完整性、有效性或一致性指标。为规则写清分母、责任人和复查条件。
Choose completeness, validity or consistency measures based on use. Specify denominator, owner and review conditions.

title: 统计判断
Statistical reasoning
purpose: 描述分布，辨认样本偏差，并判断证据能支持什么结论。
Describe distributions, identify sampling bias and judge what the evidence supports.

title: 描述统计与分布
Descriptive statistics
lesson: 用中位数和分位数补充均值。检查偏态、极端值和单位，并注明样本大小。
Complement means with medians and quantiles. Check skew, outliers and units and report sample size.

title: 抽样与偏差
Sampling and bias
lesson: 说明目标总体、抽样框和未覆盖人群。大样本也无法自动修复选择偏差。
Identify the target population, sampling frame and missing groups. A large sample alone cannot fix selection bias.

title: 实验与因果判断
Experiments and causal claims
lesson: 先定主指标、随机分配单位和分析窗口，再解读效应大小及不确定性。
Predefine the primary metric, unit of randomization and analysis window, then interpret effect size and uncertainty.

title: 建模与表达
Modeling and communication
purpose: 建立可解释的数据模型，复核汇总口径，再把发现写成可核对的建议。
Build an interpretable model, check aggregations and make a verifiable recommendation.

title: 事实表与维度
Facts and dimensions
lesson: 先声明事实表粒度，再分离用于筛选或分组的维度。汇总前确认连接不会复制度量。
Declare fact-table grain and separate dimensions for filtering or grouping. Check joins before aggregating measures.

title: 表格透视与对账
Pivot tables and reconciliation
lesson: 透视表按行列字段分组。核对值字段采用求和还是计数，也要确认数据范围和筛选条件。
A pivot table groups rows by its row and column fields. Check whether values are summed or counted, and verify the data range and filters.

title: 图表与阅读顺序
Charts and reading order
lesson: 从读者的问题选择编码。比较分类可用条形图，时间趋势用连续时间轴，并给出单位和样本。
Choose an encoding for the reader’s question. Use bars for category comparison or a continuous time axis for trends. Label units and sample.

title: 分析简报与限制
Decision brief and limitations
lesson: 先给结论和证据，再交代范围、替代解释与下一步。把观察、推测和决策分开表达。
Lead with the finding and evidence, then give scope, alternative explanations and next actions. Separate observation from interpretation.

title: 数据与建模
Data and modeling
purpose: 从定义预测目标开始，建立可对照、可复现的模型基线。
Define a prediction target and build a reproducible baseline.

title: 任务定义与基线
Task and baseline
lesson: 先定预测对象、标签、使用时间点和代价，再选能比较的简单基线。
Define the prediction unit, label, time of use and cost before choosing a simple baseline.

title: Python 数据准备
Python data preparation
lesson: 用 pandas 声明标识字段类型，并把日期解析失败与原始缺失分开记录。数据准备脚本应能对同一原始文件重复运行。
Declare identifier types in pandas and track date parse failures separately from original missing values. Run the preparation script on the same raw input reproducibly.

title: 数据切分与泄漏
Splits and leakage
lesson: 切分后再拟合预处理。按人、组织或时间分组，避免同一来源在训练和测试中重复。
Split before fitting preprocessing. Group by person, organization or time to avoid overlap.

title: 泛化与误差分析
Generalization and errors
lesson: 对比训练和验证误差，按有意义的切片查错，并用留出集作最终核验。
Compare training and validation errors, inspect meaningful slices and reserve a final holdout.

title: 生成式 AI 应用
Generative AI applications
purpose: 定义应用契约、检索上下文和受控的工具执行边界。
Define application contracts, retrieval context and controlled tool boundaries.

title: 提示与输出契约
Prompt and output contract
lesson: 定义输入、结构化输出和失败路径。解析后校验字段、枚举和值域，并保留人工接管。
Specify inputs, structured outputs and failure handling. Validate fields, enums and values after parsing.

title: 检索与出处
Retrieval and grounding
lesson: 同时核对命中文档与回答依据。记录来源、版本和片段；证据不足时保留未知。
Inspect both retrieved documents and support for the answer. Keep source, version and excerpt references.

title: 工具调用与权限
Tool calls and authorization
lesson: 限制工具、参数和账号范围。把数据和指令分开，在应用侧确认高影响操作。
Limit tools, arguments and account scope. Separate data from instructions and confirm high-impact actions.

title: 评测与复核
Evaluation and review
purpose: 用固定样本、可解释规则和严重错误门槛评价候选。
Compare candidates with fixed examples, explicit rules and critical-error gates.

title: 分类指标与阈值
Classification metrics and thresholds
lesson: 根据假阳性和假阴性的代价选择指标。分别说明阈值、准确性与评估样本。
Choose measures based on false-positive and false-negative cost. Report threshold, scores and sample.

title: 评测样本与评分
Cases and rubrics
lesson: 准备典型、边界和失败案例，提前定义成功标准、严重错误与复核方式。
Include typical, boundary and failure cases. Define success, critical errors and review before scoring.

title: 错例归因与复测
Error analysis and retesting
lesson: 把错误归为检索、规则、执行或表达问题。修改后回测已知错例，并使用独立样本复核。
Group failures by retrieval, policy, execution or expression. Rerun known failures and check independent examples.

title: 上线与治理
Release and governance
purpose: 记录模型与数据版本，监控上线质量并制定人工升级规则。
Track model and data versions, monitor live quality and define human escalation.

title: 版本与可复现
Versioning and reproducibility
lesson: 记录模型、提示、数据、代码和评分规则版本。记录不可控的随机性及运行条件。
Record model, prompt, data, code and rubric versions along with randomness and run conditions.

title: 监测与分布漂移
Monitoring and drift
lesson: 同时观察输入、输出、失败率和人工处理结果。把变化信号与已确认的质量下降分开。
Monitor inputs, outputs, failures and human outcomes. Separate distribution signals from confirmed degradation.

title: 风险与人工接管
Risk and human oversight
lesson: 明确可自动完成、需人工复核和必须停止的情况。记录责任、审计与复盘。
Define when to automate, route to review or stop. Keep ownership, audit and follow-up.

title: 网络与授权边界
Network and scope
purpose: 看清请求经过哪里、哪些信息受保护，以及检查的授权范围。
Trace requests, understand what is protected and define authorized scope.

title: DNS 与请求路径
DNS and request paths
lesson: 把域名解析、传输连接和应用请求分开。一次失败要先定位发生在哪一层。
Separate name resolution, the transport connection and the application request. Locate the failing layer first.

title: TLS 与传输信任
TLS and transport trust
lesson: TLS 保护连接上的数据，并依赖正确的服务端身份验证。代理终止 TLS 后要重新看下一跳边界。
TLS protects a connection and relies on correct server authentication. Reassess the next hop after proxy termination.

title: 测试范围与风险
Authorized testing scope
lesson: 把资产、身份、动作、时间和停止条件写清。生产资产和真实账号要依据明确授权处理。
Record assets, identities, actions, timing and stop conditions. Treat production and real accounts according to explicit authorization.

title: 身份与访问控制
Identity and access
purpose: 核对身份、资源授权与密钥处理，保护系统权限边界。
Review identity, resource authorization and secrets handling.

title: 身份验证与会话
Authentication and sessions
lesson: 验证身份后再创建会话；密码重置或权限变更要处理会话生命周期。
Establish sessions after authentication and manage their lifetime when credentials or privileges change.

title: 资源授权与最小权限
Resource authorization
lesson: 服务端逐次验证主体、动作与资源。默认拒绝，分别测横向越权和角色越权。
Check subject, action and resource on the server for each request. Default to deny and test horizontal and vertical boundaries.

title: 密钥保管与轮换
Secret storage and rotation
lesson: 密钥应受访问控制和审计。泄漏后先撤销或轮换，再核对影响和历史副本。
Protect secrets with access controls and audit. On exposure, revoke or rotate and review impact and retained copies.

title: 检测与事件响应
Detection and response
purpose: 归并多来源证据，区分观察与解释，并给出可复核的升级决定。
Correlate evidence across sources, distinguish observation from explanation and make a reviewable escalation.

title: 日志时间与关联
Event time and correlation
lesson: 保留原时区与事件时间。关联身份、来源、目标、会话及事件类型，标明缺口。
Preserve time zones and event timestamps. Correlate identity, source, target, session and event type and record gaps.

title: 异常分诊与交叉复核
Alert triage
lesson: 警报是线索。查已知变更、目标与来源，比较替代解释和采集缺口。
Treat alerts as clues. Compare known changes, targets, sources, alternate explanations and collection gaps.

title: 事件升级与交接
Incident escalation
lesson: 交接时区分已知、推断与未知，列出证据、影响、应急动作、授权和下一次更新。
Handoff distinguishes facts, inference and unknowns, with evidence, impact, authorized actions and next update.

title: 应用安全
Application security
purpose: 画出信任边界，用验证标准检查输入、权限和复测证据。
Map trust boundaries and verify inputs, permissions and retests against explicit controls.

title: 信任边界与威胁建模
Trust boundaries and threats
lesson: 从数据流、资产和信任边界识别风险。每个风险要能对应验证或缓解措施。
Use data flows, assets and trust boundaries to identify risks. Tie each threat to a verification or mitigation.

title: 输入校验与查询安全
Input and query safety
lesson: 为输入明确格式与范围。查询用参数绑定；动态列名使用受控映射。
Specify input format and bounds. Bind query parameters and map dynamic column names to an allowlist.

title: 安全验证与回归
Security verification and regression
lesson: 把控制转为有预期的测试。记录版本、身份、步骤、结果和复测边界。
Turn a control into a test with a specific expected result. Record version, identity, steps and retest scope.

title: 系统与网络
Systems and networking
purpose: 定位进程、权限和请求故障的边界。
Locate failures in processes, permissions and the request path.

title: 服务账号与权限
Service accounts and permissions
lesson: 识别进程实际身份和所需权限，分别检查目录遍历与文件读写。
Identify the actual service identity and required access. Check directory traversal separately from file access.

title: 请求链路与状态码
Request path and HTTP status
lesson: 从客户端到网关和应用逐段核对成功条件。代理错误与应用返回需用日志定位。
Check the path from client through proxy to application. Use logs to locate gateway and application errors.

title: 资源信号与定位
Resource signals and diagnosis
lesson: 先看错误、延迟、流量和饱和度，再区分触发因素、瓶颈与用户影响。
Start with errors, latency, traffic and saturation, then separate triggers, bottlenecks and impact.

title: 交付与基础设施
Delivery and infrastructure
purpose: 把构建、部署与配置变成可审查、可重复的过程。
Make builds, deployments and infrastructure repeatable and reviewable.

title: 容器构建与镜像
Container builds and images
lesson: 记录镜像基础、依赖与构建上下文，运行时注入配置和凭据。
Record the base image, dependencies and build context. Inject configuration and secrets at runtime.

title: 部署与健康探针
Deployments and probes
lesson: 滚动更新逐步替换副本。就绪探针决定是否接收流量，存活探针用于决定重启。
Rolling updates replace replicas gradually. Readiness gates traffic and liveness can trigger restarts.

title: 基础设施配置与状态
Infrastructure configuration and state
lesson: 评审计划差异和删除动作。将基础设施状态视为需访问控制的共享记录。
Review planned differences and deletions. Treat infrastructure state as a shared record that needs access controls.

title: 可观测性与可靠性
Observability and reliability
purpose: 把用户体验转成可观察指标、目标和可行动的告警。
Translate user experience into observable signals, objectives and actionable alerts.

title: 服务信号与告警
Service signals and alerts
lesson: 监测流量、延迟、错误和饱和度。告警关联用户影响和可执行动作。
Track traffic, latency, errors and saturation. Alerts should connect impact to an action.

title: SLI、SLO 与误差预算
SLIs, SLOs and error budgets
lesson: 以好事件数除以有效事件数定义服务指标。目标缺口决定可容许的坏事件比例。
Define indicators as good events divided by valid events. The objective implies a tolerated bad-event fraction.

title: 关联日志、指标和追踪
Logs, metrics and traces
lesson: 指标定位时间窗，追踪区分调用段，日志提供单次事件的细节。
Use metrics to find the time window, traces to inspect call segments, and logs for event details.

title: 变更、回退与复盘
Change and incident recovery
purpose: 根据发布证据暂停或回退，验证恢复并交接后续行动。
Pause or roll back on evidence, verify recovery and hand off follow-up.

title: 灰度发布与门槛
Canary release gates
lesson: 预设对照、样本量、阈值和暂停规则，比较相同时间窗的候选组与稳定组。
Set controls, sample size, thresholds and pause rules before comparing candidate and stable groups.

title: 回退与恢复验收
Rollback and recovery verification
lesson: 回退确认版本和数据兼容。恢复需通过用户路径及一段稳定观察。
Confirm target version and data compatibility before rollback. Verify a user path and a stable observation window.

title: 事件交接与复盘
Incident handoff and postmortem
lesson: 记录影响、时间线、证据和未决问题。改进动作应有负责人和可验证结果。
Record impact, timeline, evidence and open issues. Improvements need owners and verifiable outcomes.

title: Web 基础
Web foundations
purpose: 建立有语义的文档、响应式布局与可预测的交互。
Build semantic documents, responsive layouts and predictable interactions.

title: 语义化 HTML
Semantic HTML
lesson: 优先选择原生元素表达含义。表单控件需要可识别标签。
Use native elements for meaning. Give each form control an accessible label.

title: 响应式 CSS 布局
Responsive CSS layout
lesson: 根据内容选 Grid 或 Flexbox。允许项目收缩和换行，在窄屏及长文案下验证。
Choose Grid or Flexbox for the content. Allow shrinking and wrapping and test narrow screens and long labels.

title: JavaScript 与事件
JavaScript and events
lesson: 理解事件目标、传播、默认行为与状态更新。事件监听按元素生命周期清理。
Understand targets, propagation, default actions and state updates. Clean up listeners with their lifecycle.

title: 交互与无障碍
Interaction and accessibility
purpose: 让用户在多种输入方式和状态下完成同一任务。
Support the same task across input methods and application states.

title: 键盘与焦点
Keyboard and focus
lesson: 按阅读顺序安排键盘焦点。打开对话框移动焦点，关闭后返回触发入口。
Follow reading order for keyboard focus. Move focus into dialogs and return it on close.

title: 表单错误与提示
Form errors and feedback
lesson: 把错误描述和字段关联，保留输入。状态变化应让辅助技术感知。
Associate errors with fields and preserve input. Expose relevant status changes to assistive technology.

title: 请求与异步状态
Requests and async states
lesson: 区分加载、空结果、错误与成功，校验 HTTP 状态。较旧的请求不能覆盖最新操作。
Separate loading, empty, error and success states. Check HTTP status and keep stale responses from overwriting newer actions.

title: 组件与工程化
Components and tooling
purpose: 维护清晰的组件契约和可复现的构建。
Maintain clear component contracts and repeatable builds.

title: 组件状态归属
Component state ownership
lesson: 把共享状态放在需要它的共同祖先。派生值在渲染时计算，避免两个状态互相追赶。
Keep shared state in the nearest common owner and derive values during rendering where possible.

title: 依赖锁定与构建
Dependencies and builds
lesson: 用锁文件固定依赖解析。持续集成中验证干净安装、构建与输出。
Pin resolution in a lockfile. Verify clean install, build and output in CI.

title: 端到端交互检查
End-to-end interaction tests
lesson: 按用户可见语义定位，使用等待断言，并准备独立且可重复的数据。
Locate by user-visible semantics, use retrying assertions and isolate repeatable data.

title: 性能与上线
Performance and release
purpose: 度量体验、校验浏览器安全边界并用清单上线。
Measure experience, check browser security boundaries and release with evidence.

title: 加载与交互体验
Loading and interaction
lesson: 分别核对主要内容加载、交互响应和布局稳定。区分受控实验与用户现场数据。
Measure loading, interaction responsiveness and layout stability. Distinguish lab runs from field data.

title: 浏览器内容安全
Browser content security
lesson: 把用户文本当数据呈现。CSP 限制脚本和资源来源，并用报告观察策略影响。
Render untrusted text as data. Use CSP to restrict script and resource sources and observe reports.

title: 上线验收与回归
Release and regression checks
lesson: 覆盖关键路径、视口和输入方式。记录浏览器、版本、结果以及未检查范围。
Cover key journeys, viewports and input methods. Record browser, build, result and gaps.

title: 接口与业务规则
APIs and business rules
purpose: 把请求、响应和状态变化写成可验证的服务契约。
Define verifiable contracts for requests, responses and state changes.

title: HTTP 与状态码
HTTP and status codes
lesson: 区分安全与幂等语义。明确成功、输入无效、未认证和无权限各自的响应。
Distinguish safety and idempotency. Specify success, invalid input, unauthenticated and forbidden outcomes.

title: OpenAPI 与错误契约
OpenAPI and error contracts
lesson: 为路径、参数、正文、响应状态和安全要求声明结构，并提供示例。
Declare paths, parameters, bodies, response statuses and security requirements with examples.

title: Java 服务分层
Java service boundaries
lesson: 以 Java 和 Spring MVC 为例，请求对象校验字段形状，服务层处理订单规则，持久层负责数据读写。将订单规则留在服务中，可以在批处理和 HTTP 请求中共用。

In Java with Spring MVC, validate request fields at the boundary, apply order rules in the service and read or write in the persistence layer. A batch job can reuse the same order rules as the HTTP endpoint.

title: 业务状态与幂等
State transitions and idempotency
lesson: 列出合法的状态转换，约束并行更新；重复请求应能辨认同一业务操作。
Define allowed state transitions, constrain concurrent writes and identify retries of the same operation.

title: 数据与事务
Data and transactions
purpose: 用数据约束保护一致性，用执行计划定位查询代价。
Protect consistency with constraints and inspect query plans for cost.

title: 关系模型与约束
Relational design and constraints
lesson: 主键识别行，外键维护引用，唯一和检查约束表达数据不变量。
Primary keys identify rows, foreign keys protect references and unique or check constraints encode invariants.

title: 事务与并发更新
Transactions and concurrency
lesson: 事务保证相关写入一起提交或撤销。并发写入要处理冲突和不变量。
Transactions commit or roll back related writes together. Concurrent updates must respect invariants.

title: 索引与查询计划
Indexes and query plans
lesson: 用执行计划看访问方式和估计行数，结合数据量与筛选比例评估索引。
Read access methods and row estimates and assess indexes against volume and selectivity.

title: 认证与安全边界
Authentication and security
purpose: 分开核对身份、资源权限和输入来源。
Check identity, resource permissions and untrusted input separately.

title: 会话生命周期
Session lifecycle
lesson: 在服务端检查会话有效期与撤销状态。确保退出、权限变化和密码重置行为明确。
Verify expiry and revocation server-side. Specify logout, privilege changes and reset behavior.

title: 对象访问控制
Object authorization
lesson: 每次请求按主体、操作和资源做授权。测试本人、他人和受限角色。
Authorize each request by subject, action and resource. Test own, other and restricted-role access.

title: 输入校验与安全查询
Validation and safe queries
lesson: 在可信边界校验类型、长度和值域。数据库查询绑定参数，错误响应保留必要信息。
Validate type, length and bounds at the trust boundary. Bind database parameters and return appropriate error details.

title: 验证与可观测性
Verification and observability
purpose: 验证交互边界、受控重试与故障定位。
Verify integration boundaries, retries and diagnosability.

title: 集成与契约测试
Integration and contract tests
lesson: 用集成测试覆盖存储、权限和错误映射。用契约检查生产者与消费者的结构一致。
Test persistence, authorization and error mapping in integration and check producer–consumer contracts.

title: 超时与重试边界
Timeout and retry limits
lesson: 区分暂时故障和永久失败，设置时间预算、退避与最大尝试。重试写入需要幂等。
Separate temporary from permanent failures and set deadlines, backoff and attempt limits. Retried writes need idempotency.

title: 服务日志与链路追踪
Service logs and tracing
lesson: 用结构化日志定位请求，结合指标、追踪与请求标识。敏感值在采集前过滤。
Use structured logs with metrics, traces and request IDs. Filter sensitive values before collection.

title: 数据模型与存储
Modeling and storage
purpose: 确定粒度、连接和分区，让下游能解释数据。
Choose grain, joins and partitions so downstream data is interpretable.

title: 事实粒度与键
Dataset grain and keys
lesson: 先声明一行代表什么，再定义事实与维度键和可加性。
Declare what one row represents before choosing fact/dimension keys and additivity.

title: SQL 转换与对账
SQL transforms and reconciliation
lesson: 将转换拆为可验证步骤，关联前确认唯一性，聚合前后核对计数和关键金额。
Split transformations into verifiable steps. Check key uniqueness before joins and reconcile counts and values across stages.

title: 分区与模式演进
Partitions and schema evolution
lesson: 按访问模式选择分区，评估写入分布。模式变化要处理读写兼容和历史数据。
Partition for access patterns and consider write distribution. Schema changes need reader/writer and historical compatibility.

title: 批处理与编排
Batch and orchestration
purpose: 让任务可重跑、可补数，并在依赖就绪后发布。
Make jobs repeatable and backfillable and publish after dependencies are ready.

title: DAG 与数据窗口
DAGs and data intervals
lesson: 把逻辑数据窗口和实际执行时间分开。明确输入就绪条件和任务依赖。
Separate logical data windows from execution time. Define readiness and dependencies.

title: 幂等写入与失败恢复
Idempotent batch writes
lesson: 给输出固定键或分区；可重试任务应能替换目标或按键合并，避免重复追加。
Use stable keys or partitions; retriable tasks should replace or merge without duplicate appends.

title: 补数与依赖恢复
Backfill and dependency recovery
lesson: 按逻辑窗口补数，限定并发和下游重算范围，记录缺口及对账结果。
Backfill logical windows with bounded concurrency and affected downstream rebuilds. Log gaps and reconciliation.

title: 流式与增量
Streaming and incremental data
purpose: 对齐事件时间，处理迟到、重复和中断后重放。
Use event time and handle late arrivals, duplicates and replay after interruption.

title: 事件时间与水位线
Event time and watermarks
lesson: 事件发生时间可能早于到达时间。水位线推进窗口进度，迟到仍需处理策略。
Event time can precede arrival. Watermarks advance window progress and late data still needs policy.

title: 重复事件与重放
Deduplication and replay
lesson: 为事件设置稳定 ID 和明确去重窗口。消费恢复与目标写入需要一起验证。
Use stable event IDs and explicit deduplication horizons. Verify consumer recovery together with sink writes.

title: 增量结果与迟到修正
Incremental validation and late corrections
lesson: 比较增量与全量在相同窗口的结果。记录可修正窗口、版本和下游通知。
Compare incremental and full results for the same interval. Record correction windows, versions and downstream notification.

title: 质量、血缘与运维
Quality, lineage and operations
purpose: 为下游提供校验、来源和能追踪的问题处理。
Give downstream consumers checks, provenance and traceable incident handling.

title: 约束与数据测试
Constraints and data tests
lesson: 明确完整性、唯一性、关系与业务规则，设定何时拦截或告警。
Specify completeness, uniqueness, relationships and business rules and decide when to block or warn.

title: 数据血缘与影响分析
Lineage and impact
lesson: 把作业、运行、输入与输出数据集连起来，记录版本、来源与影响路径。
Link jobs and runs to input and output datasets, preserving version, provenance and impact path.

title: 新鲜度与质量事件
Freshness and data incidents
lesson: 把数据到达延迟、任务成功与数据可用性分开，记录影响和复查责任。
Separate data arrival, job success and usability; record impact and review ownership.

title: 需求与风险
Requirements and risk
purpose: 从需求与风险确定优先场景、分层和覆盖范围。
Turn requirements and risk into priorities, test levels and coverage.

title: 验收条件与可追踪性
Acceptance and traceability
lesson: 从需求提取可观察的前置条件、动作和预期。用关联表核对未覆盖项。
Extract observable preconditions, actions and expected outcomes. Use traceability to find gaps.

title: 产品风险与优先级
Product risk and priority
lesson: 用可能性与影响评估产品风险，把有限时间先给高影响路径。
Assess likelihood and impact and prioritize high-risk flows when time is limited.

title: 测试层级与策略
Test levels and strategy
lesson: 在最合适的层级验证风险。覆盖单元、集成、系统和用户验收的不同目标。
Verify each risk at an appropriate level. Unit, integration, system and acceptance have different objectives.

title: 测试设计技术
Test design techniques
purpose: 用分区、决策表和状态转换减少遗漏。
Use partitions, decision tables and transitions to reduce gaps.

title: 等价类与边界值
Partitions and boundaries
lesson: 按行为划分有效和无效类。对有序边界选取刚好在界内、界外的值。
Partition by behavior. For ordered ranges, sample at the boundary and just outside.

title: 决策表与组合
Decision tables and combinations
lesson: 把条件组合映射为动作。区分不可能条件与不影响结果的条件。
Map condition combinations to actions. Distinguish impossible combinations from irrelevant conditions.

title: 状态转换与非法事件
State transitions and invalid events
lesson: 列出当前状态、事件、条件和下一状态。检查合法转换与被拒绝的转换。
Map current state, event, condition and next state. Test allowed and denied transitions.

title: 执行、缺陷与复核
Execution and defects
purpose: 留下可重现的证据，正确区分缺陷确认与回归。
Capture reproducible evidence and separate confirmation testing from regression.

title: 探索式测试
Exploratory testing
lesson: 给探索设定主题、范围和时间。边学边设计用例，并记录线索和后续。
Set a charter, scope and timebox. Design while learning and record findings and next checks.

title: 缺陷复现与分级
Defect reproduction
lesson: 记录版本、环境、前置、步骤、预期、实际与证据。区分影响严重度和处理优先级。
Record build, environment, preconditions, steps, expected/actual and evidence. Separate severity from priority.

title: 确认测试与回归
Confirmation and regression
lesson: 先确认原缺陷不再出现，再按变更影响检查周边路径。记录未跑范围。
Confirm the original failure is fixed, then check surrounding paths based on impact. Record unrun scope.

title: 自动化与持续交付
Automation and CI
purpose: 选择稳定断言，隔离测试数据，留下持续集成证据。
Choose stable assertions, isolate data and produce CI evidence.

title: 测试数据与隔离
Test data and isolation
lesson: 用独立且可重置的测试数据。参数化覆盖同一规则的边界，避免用例相互依赖。
Use isolated, resettable data. Parameterize boundary cases and avoid inter-test dependencies.

title: 稳定定位与断言
Stable locators and assertions
lesson: 围绕可见行为与角色定位，并等待实际条件。失败时保留可定位证据。
Locate user-facing behavior and roles and wait for real conditions. Capture diagnostic evidence on failure.

title: 持续集成与失败证据
CI and failure evidence
lesson: 在明确版本和环境下运行关键测试。保留日志与报告，区分可重复缺陷与不稳定测试。
Run key checks under known versions and environment. Retain logs and reports and distinguish reproducible bugs from flakes.

title: 需求与问题分解
Requirements and decomposition
purpose: 把模糊任务变成可观察、可分解的行为。
Turn vague requests into observable, decomposed behavior.

title: 问题与输入输出
Problem and input/output
lesson: 定义输入、输出、假设和边界；把不明确的条件列为待确认。
Define inputs, outputs, assumptions and boundaries. Keep ambiguous conditions open.

title: 验收条件与交付切片
Acceptance and delivery slices
lesson: 按用户价值拆小。每个切片都包含可观察结果和最小验证。
Split by user value. Each slice needs an observable outcome and a minimum check.

title: 模块职责与接口
Module boundaries and interfaces
lesson: 让相关职责归在一起，让易变化细节留在边界后。写清模块的输入输出。
Group related responsibilities and place volatile details behind interfaces. Specify inputs and outputs.

title: 编码与算法
Coding and algorithms
purpose: 用合适的数据结构与控制流实现规则，处理异常输入。
Implement rules with appropriate data structures, control flow and error handling.

title: 控制流与函数
Control flow and functions
lesson: 把一个函数限定在清晰的职责内，安排正常路径、提前返回和边界值。
Keep each function focused and handle normal flow, early returns and edge cases.

title: 数据结构与复杂度
Data structures and complexity
lesson: 按访问和修改模式选序列、映射或集合。评估输入增长时操作的代价。
Choose sequences, maps or sets for access and mutation patterns. Consider cost as input grows.

title: 错误处理与边界输入
Errors and edge cases
lesson: 区分可预期输入错误、系统失败和缺陷。提供具体错误且保留上下文。
Distinguish expected input errors, system failures and bugs. Preserve useful error context.

title: 验证与演进
Verification and evolution
purpose: 用测试、调试与安全重构验证代码变化。
Verify changes through tests, debugging and safe refactoring.

title: 单元测试与边界
Unit tests and boundaries
lesson: 一个测试关注一个明确行为。覆盖普通、边界和错误输入，保留具体预期。
Focus tests on clear behavior with ordinary, boundary and invalid inputs and explicit outcomes.

title: 复现与定位
Reproduction and debugging
lesson: 缩小到最小可复现场景，提出假设并用对照测试排除。
Reduce to a minimal reproduction and test hypotheses using controls.

title: 重构与兼容性
Refactoring and compatibility
lesson: 在有回归依据时小步调整结构。保持外部契约，除非显式计划变更。
Change structure in small steps with regression coverage. Preserve external behavior unless changing it deliberately.

title: 协作与发布
Collaboration and release
purpose: 用版本历史、审查和发布记录让团队能接手。
Use history, review and release notes to support team handoff.

title: Git 分支与合并
Git branches and merges
lesson: 在可审查分支上工作。解决冲突时保留双方意图并运行相关检查。
Work in reviewable branches. Resolve conflicts by preserving both intentions and running relevant checks.

title: 代码审查与反馈
Code review
lesson: 审查关注正确性、测试、可维护性和范围。用可定位反馈描述问题和影响。
Review correctness, tests, maintainability and scope. Give feedback with location and impact.

title: 发布版本与交接
Versioned releases and handoff
lesson: 记录版本、范围、验证和迁移说明。出问题时能定位具体构建并回退。
Record version, scope, checks and migration notes. Identify the exact build for rollback.

title: 需求与实施范围
Discovery and scope
purpose: 和使用方核对流程、范围、验收与责任。
Confirm workflows, scope, acceptance and ownership with stakeholders.

title: 现状与目标流程
Current and target workflows
lesson: 记录实际业务角色、输入、例外与交接，区分观察和假设。
Record current roles, inputs, exceptions and handoffs, distinguishing observations from assumptions.

title: 范围与验收标准
Scope and acceptance criteria
lesson: 将范围、约束和验收写成可复核条目，明确审批人与变更路径。
Write verifiable scope, constraints and acceptance with approvers and a change process.

title: 依赖、责任与升级
Dependencies and ownership
lesson: 为前置事项、权限和审批指定责任人、期限、证据与升级方式。
Assign owners, dates, evidence and escalation for dependencies, access and approvals.

title: 配置、权限与迁移
Configuration, access and migration
purpose: 在受控环境复现配置，核对角色和迁移前后数据。
Reproduce configuration in a controlled environment and check access and migrated data.

title: 环境与配置基线
Environments and baselines
lesson: 登记环境、依赖、版本和可重复配置。将测试和生产的凭据隔离。
Record environments, dependencies, versions and repeatable configuration. Separate test and production credentials.

title: 角色权限与复核
Role matrix and review
lesson: 以岗位职责定义权限。用允许和拒绝案例验证角色，核对上线审批。
Define privileges from job duties. Verify allowed and denied paths with approval.

title: 迁移、对账与修正
Migration and reconciliation
lesson: 先映射字段、做试迁并保存失败清单。核对计数、主键、业务总量和抽样记录。
Map fields and rehearse migration with a failure register. Reconcile counts, keys, totals and samples.

title: 验收与上线切换
Acceptance and cutover
purpose: 用用户验收和切换演练确定是否可上线。
Use user acceptance and a rehearsal to decide readiness.

title: 用户验收测试
User acceptance testing
lesson: 由代表性业务角色执行关键任务，记录结果、缺陷、剩余风险和批准。
Have representative business users run critical journeys and record results, defects, risks and approval.

title: 切换步骤与演练
Cutover and rehearsal
lesson: 按时间列冻结、备份、迁移、切换、验证和通知。每步要有负责人和判断条件。
Sequence freeze, backup, migration, switch, verification and notice with owners and gates.

title: 上线判断与回退
Go/no-go and rollback
lesson: 预定义上线和回退门槛。验证数据兼容、可恢复性和谁批准执行。
Define go/no-go and rollback gates. Verify compatibility, recovery and approvers.

title: 交接、培训与支持
Handover, training and support
purpose: 让运维、业务和一线支持能接手并验证后续问题。
Equip operations, business users and support to take ownership.

title: 按角色培训与验收
Role-based training
lesson: 按角色和任务设计练习，保存材料、问题入口和可观察的练习结果。
Train by role and task, retaining materials, question channels and observable outcomes.

title: 报障分诊与复现
Support triage and reproduction
lesson: 收集版本、环境、影响、复现和最近变化。按严重程度与服务约定升级。
Collect build, environment, impact, steps and recent changes. Escalate using severity and service agreements.

title: 移交清单与跟进
Handoff and follow-up
lesson: 交付环境、手册、访问申请、验收和未决事项，给后续责任和更新时间。
Hand over environments, runbooks, access requests, acceptance and open items with owners and update dates.
